data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for Apple CallKit integration on iOS applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides native integration with the iOS CallKit framework, allowing Flutter apps to handle incoming and outgoing VoIP calls, call blocking, and call identification using Call Directory extensions.
use_when: You are building a VoIP application on iOS that requires native CallKit integration.
You need to handle incoming VoIP push notifications and present the native iOS call UI.
avoid_when: You are targeting Android platforms (Android support was removed in version 2.1.0).
You do not need native OS-level phone integration for your app.
strengths: Closely mirrors the native iOS CallKit API structure.
Supports Call Directory app extensions for call blocking and identification.
weaknesses: iOS only; Android is not supported.
Requires manual configuration in native iOS code (AppDelegate, Info.plist).
data.setup_notes: Requires adding UIBackgroundModes voip to Info.plist and native Swift/Objective-C code configuration for push notifications and CallKit setup.
